body:
Hi, I know this map might look small but the goal of this project was to increase sky bridging. 

Author: EDJM9
Team Size: 10v10
XML & Download: i need that
Images: https://imgur.com/a/xJJeM

It might become a little stalematey,  but the team who has their sky bridge up first should have an easier time winning. Its more about sky bridge control.
